# Automation Safety Checklist: Weekly Unattended Distill with Rolling Per-Theme Review PRs

**Purpose**: Validate unattended automation safety, trust boundaries, and human-gate integrity for weekly distill — ensures spec does not weaken #153/#194/#203 guards
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [018-weekly-distill-automation](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Trigger & Dispatch Idempotency

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements specified for dedup invariant — at most one open `dewey-distill` issue — across sequential and overlapping workflow runs? [Spec §FR-003, US1 IS+AS]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements specified for re-trigger behavior (post `<!-- dewey-distill-trigger -->` comment) vs. create-new-issue behavior with distinct Given/When/Then? [Spec §FR-002, US1 AS-2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements specified for `gh-hud#28` contract exposure (label `dewey-distill`, assignee, dispatch command `/dewey-distill-auto #{num}` as `autonomy`) without requiring reverse-engineering? [Spec §FR-004, FR-022]
- [ ] CHK004 Are failure requirements specified when workflow lacks permissions (contents:read, issues:write, pull-requests:write) or label does not exist? [Plan §Constraints, contracts/workflow-template.md]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements specified for manual re-trigger race (scheduled + `workflow_dispatch` overlap) preserving single-issue invariant? [Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003]

## Deterministic Scope & Policy Handling

- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements specified for git-only scope computation (`git ls-tree` on `learnings/` minus `compiled/sources`) with exact set equality as success criterion? [Spec §FR-005, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements specified for prohibition of `question` tool in unattended mode with log-assertion verifiability? [Spec §FR-006, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements specified for optional policy file `.uf/dewey/distill-policy.yaml` absent vs. present behavior (no error vs. tag/store exclusions)? [Spec §FR-007, Data Model DistillPolicy]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements specified for malformed/non-existent policy entry handling (warn + skip, not fatal)? [Spec §Edge Cases, Research D-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements specified for degraded mode when repo is non-git or lacks default-branch ref (filesystem scan, `filesystem:degraded` provenance, no blob-equality)? [Spec §Edge Cases, FR-005 note]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements specified for empty scope no-op (no PR, no spurious comment, recorded result)? [Spec §FR-021, SC-004, US2 AS-5]

## Assignment, Supersession & Grouping

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements specified for theme assignment using embeddings + current compile clustering with tag-fallback when embeddings unavailable? [Spec §FR-008, Research D-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements specified for supersession coercion — learnings linked via `supersedes` (#150) MUST co-locate in same theme with metadata recorded? [Spec §FR-009, US3 AS-2]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements specified for per-decision provenance logging (embedding distance, rule name, or judge identity) + confidence value? [Spec §FR-010, US3 AS-3]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements specified for deterministic tie-breaker (closest centroid) when ambiguity margin narrow and no LLM judge configured? [Spec §US3 AS-4, Research D-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for tag-sprawl benefit (394 near-duplicate tags grouped semantically) as grouping validation rather than enumerated tag list? [Spec §US3 narrative]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements specified for new-theme bucket creation when no existing compiled article matches cluster? [Spec §US3 IT, FR-008]

## Rolling PRs, Review Queue & Human Preservation

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements specified for per-theme branch naming `dewey-distill/<theme>` (sanitized `[a-z0-9-_/]+`, max 100 chars) and 1:1 theme→PR mapping? [Data Model RollingPR, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements specified for rebase/update preservation — human commits (author ≠ distiller) and review comments survive rebase, not silently overwritten? [Spec §FR-015, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements specified for conflict surfacing (`needs-human-resolution` label, conflict files noted) rather than auto-resolve dropping human edits? [Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements specified for duplicate-prevention — open PR exists → update via rebase, no second PR per theme; closed PR → fresh PR? [Spec §FR-011, SC-005, US4 AS-2/AS-6]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements specified for no-empty-push invariant — second run with no new learnings leaves existing theme PR SHA stable? [Spec §US4 AS-5, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements specified for review queue PR body per article (knowledge-change summary, newly cited identities, supersessions, lint drift #147) as primary human review surface? [Spec §FR-013, Research D-006]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements specified for CODEOWNERS + ruleset 26764121 `human-gate` blocking merge until code-owner approval (referenced, not reimplemented)? [Spec §FR-014, #194 dependency]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements specified that rolling PRs contain only `tier: draft` articles plus hygiene edits (dedup, superseded, stale) and never `tier: validated`? [Spec §FR-012, SC-003]

## Privilege Narrowing & Trust Boundaries

- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements specified for distiller allowlist (`read`, `list_pages`, `get_page`, `lint`, `compile`, `curate`, `verify_candidates`, `store_compiled` draft-only, `supersede_learning`) denying `question` and any validated write? [Spec §FR-016/FR-017, contracts/distiller-allowlist.md]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements specified that allowlist grant is global `opencode-supervisor` `command: dewey-distill-auto` profile only and repo-local widening is ignored (fail-closed)? [Spec §FR-016, US5 IS, Research D-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements specified for hard prerequisite — if supervisor lacks command-scoped profiles (#51), unattended dispatch is not enabled and records no-op + notice `supervisor command profile unavailable, unattended distill skipped` with no degraded allowlist? [Spec §Assumptions, Research D-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified that server-side guard rejects any `tier: validated` write in distiller context (file stays `draft`) with permissions error, not client-side advisory? [Plan §Constraints, Data Model RollingPR.tier_written]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements specified that interactive `/dewey-distill` retains both `HUMAN_GATE:` questions and full curator toolset unchanged (additive, not replacement)? [Spec §FR-018, US6]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements specified that `validated` trust is conferred only by merging CODEOWNERS-approved PR carrying `tier: validated` per #203 blob-equality, introducing no new gate or manifest? [Spec §FR-019, US6, #203 dependency]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements specified for epic #153 governance obedience (automate demotion not promotion, never turn guard off, never weaken dev guards, auto-answer isolation, draft-clamp, git vouch, append-only supersession) each traced to scoped FR/assumption? [Spec §Dependencies & Relationship to Epic #153]
